outcome: Place of delivery (home vs. health facility)
Mode of delivery (caesarean section vs. vaginal birth)
cohort: 7080 women aged 15-49 years who reported having a child during the past 5 years
finding: The prevalence of health facility delivery was 70.7%, and C-section delivery was 5.6%, with significant differences observed between urban and rural areas and associations found with educational status, household wealth, ethnicity, and ANC visits.
mod_finding: ANC visits were a significant predictor of both facility delivery and C-section delivery, particularly in rural areas.
